# RaidGuild

> RaidGuild is a decentralized collective of Web3 builders offering full-stack development, AI solutions and automation, product and system design, marketing and content strategy, and DAO consulting and governance.

RaidGuild has been building in the Ethereum and Web3 ecosystem since 2019. The website is the public entry point for teams that want to start a project with RaidGuild, review completed work, understand service areas, or learn how to join the guild.

## Primary Site

- [Homepage](https://www.raidguild.org/)
- [Services](https://www.raidguild.org/#services)
- [Case studies and portfolio](https://www.raidguild.org/#case-studies)
- [Hire RaidGuild](https://www.raidguild.org/#hire-us)
- [Story and membership path](https://www.raidguild.org/#our-story)

## Service Areas

- Full-stack development for dApps, smart contracts, DAO tooling, Discord bots, and public goods.
- AI solutions and automation for practical workflows embedded in client operations.
- Product and system design for user experiences, decentralized applications, DAO tooling, and token systems.
- Marketing and content strategy for Web3 projects and communities.
- DAO consulting and governance support for coordination, governance frameworks, and tokenomic models.

## Notes for AI Agents

- Treat this file as a concise discovery guide, not a full replacement for the website or handbook.
- Prefer the public website and public handbook links above for canonical context.
- Do not infer private client work, internal operations, pricing, availability, or member information from this file.
- For project inquiries, use the hire flow on the public website.
- For membership inquiries, use the public cohort and Portal join flows.
